notes: These are the frozen Politikweli misinformation splits.
The dataset is not yet the final multi-label study dataset.
AfriHate will be integrated in a later phase to create the is_hate_speech target.
The final multi-label dataset will use independent is_misinfo and is_hate_speech outputs.
No composite stratification by language subset was used because the smallest subset-label group was too small for reliable three-way stratification.
